verdict.rationale: Formant documents exporting telemetry through the Cloud SDK and running scripts on devices through commands. Neither is a model-training pipeline or a model-deployment capability; they are only building blocks a developer could combine into that loop. No evidence shows the product itself feeds collected data into training or ships improved models back to the fleet.

support.subject: As a developer, I can feed collected robot data into model training and deploy the improved model back to the fleet
